# apple_app_screenshot_set (Resource)

Manages the product page screenshots for one device size in one language: the images under *Previews and Screenshots* on an App Store version.

Apple groups screenshots into a set per display type — `APP_IPHONE_67` for the 6.7" iPhone, `APP_IPAD_PRO_3GEN_129` for the 12.9" iPad and so on — under an `apple_app_store_version_localization`. This resource owns one set and keeps its contents equal to `screenshots`, in order.

Files are tracked by content, not by path. The MD5 of each file is computed at plan time and compared with what Apple holds, so:

- editing an image uploads it again;
- reordering or renaming files uploads nothing — the existing screenshots are reordered;
- a screenshot added, removed or replaced by hand in App Store Connect shows as drift and is put back on the next apply.

When the localization already has a set for the display type, it is adopted, and any screenshot in it that the configuration does not name is deleted.

The file parts are sent to the presigned storage URLs Apple issues for each upload, over a separate HTTP client that never carries the App Store Connect API token.

Apple processes each image after upload and checks its pixel dimensions against the display type. An image it rejects fails the apply with Apple's reason, and the rejected upload is removed.

~> Screenshots belong to a version. A version that has been submitted accepts no changes, and the next `apple_app_store_version` starts with Apple's copy of the previous version's screenshots, which this resource then adopts.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_apps" "example" {
  bundle_id = "com.example.app"
}

resource "apple_app_store_version" "v1" {
  app_id         = data.apple_apps.example.apps[0].id
  platform       = "IOS"
  version_string = "1.0"
}

resource "apple_app_store_version_localization" "en" {
  app_store_version_id = apple_app_store_version.v1.id
  locale               = "en-US"
  description          = "Track every expense in seconds."
}

# One set per device size. The list is the display order on the App Store;
# reordering it reorders the screenshots without uploading anything, and only a
# file whose content changed is uploaded again.
resource "apple_app_screenshot_set" "iphone_67" {
  app_store_version_localization_id = apple_app_store_version_localization.en.id
  screenshot_display_type           = "APP_IPHONE_67"

  screenshots = [
    "${path.module}/screenshots/en-US/iphone67/01-home.png",
    "${path.module}/screenshots/en-US/iphone67/02-add-expense.png",
    "${path.module}/screenshots/en-US/iphone67/03-reports.png",
  ]
}

# Another device size is another set. With a directory per locale and device,
# the list can come from fileset() instead -- it returns paths sorted, so
# prefixing files with their position fixes the order:
#
#   screenshots = [for f in sort(fileset(local.ipad_dir, "*.png")) : "${local.ipad_dir}/${f}"]
resource "apple_app_screenshot_set" "ipad_13" {
  app_store_version_localization_id = apple_app_store_version_localization.en.id
  screenshot_display_type           = "APP_IPAD_PRO_3GEN_129"

  screenshots = [
    "${path.module}/screenshots/en-US/ipad13/01-home.png",
    "${path.module}/screenshots/en-US/ipad13/02-reports.png",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_store_version_localization_id` (String) The ID of the `apple_app_store_version_localization` the screenshots belong to. Cannot be changed.
- `screenshot_display_type` (String) The device size the screenshots are for. Cannot be changed. Apple's current values include `APP_IPHONE_67`, `APP_IPHONE_65`, `APP_IPHONE_61`, `APP_IPHONE_58`, `APP_IPHONE_55`, `APP_IPHONE_47`, `APP_IPHONE_40`, `APP_IPHONE_35`, `APP_IPAD_PRO_3GEN_129`, `APP_IPAD_PRO_3GEN_11`, `APP_IPAD_PRO_129`, `APP_IPAD_105`, `APP_IPAD_97`, `APP_DESKTOP`, `APP_APPLE_TV`, `APP_APPLE_VISION_PRO`, `APP_WATCH_ULTRA`, `APP_WATCH_SERIES_10`, `APP_WATCH_SERIES_7`, `APP_WATCH_SERIES_4`, `APP_WATCH_SERIES_3`, and an `IMESSAGE_APP_` counterpart of each iPhone and iPad size. Any value of that shape is accepted, so a size Apple adds later works without a provider release; Apple rejects one it does not know.
- `screenshots` (List of String) Paths to the screenshot images on the machine running Terraform, in the order the App Store shows them — PNG or JPEG, sized for the display type. Between 1 and 10. Null after an import until the configuration supplies it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique Apple-generated identifier for the screenshot set.
- `screenshot_checksums` (List of String) MD5 of each screenshot, lower-case hex, in the same order as `screenshots`. Computed from the files at plan time and compared with what Apple records. An empty entry is a screenshot Apple failed to process, which the next apply replaces.
- `screenshot_ids` (List of String) Apple's IDs for the screenshots, in the same order as `screenshots`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# The import ID is Apple's screenshot set ID. The localization and display type
# are read back from the set. screenshots stays unset until the configuration
# supplies it; when the files match what Apple holds, the next apply uploads
# nothing.
terraform import apple_app_screenshot_set.iphone_67 7c2f1e4a-58b3-4d9e-a6f0-3b8c9d2e1f47
```
